description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," illustrates the proportional contribution of various data sources to a training dataset. The chart is composed of multiple colored slices, each representing a different source and its corresponding percentage. The largest slice, colored blue, corresponds to NQ, which accounts for 31.3% of the data. The second largest slice, light blue, represents FEVER at 16.1%. Other notable contributors include MULTIFC (11.3%, red), SNLI (15.4%, orange), and VITAMINC (13.0%, light green). Smaller sources include SCITAIL (1.2%, dark green), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, very light green), and MULTINLI (0.5%, pink). The smallest contributions are from SCIFACT (0.1%, dark yellow), ENTFA (1.8%, yellow), FACTCC (2.6%, light yellow), and ANLI (4.6%, light orange). Each slice is labeled with the source name and its percentage, and the labels are connected to their respective slices with lines. The chart clearly shows that the data sources are distributed unevenly, with a few sources making up the majority of the training set.
